description: Ground-truth evaluation dataset for Privacy Compliance AI indicators with explicit manual annotations.

B1.name: Privacy Policy Name
B1.description: Identifies the explicit name or title of the privacy policy document.

B3.name: Effective Date
B3.description: Specifies the legal commencement or effective date of the privacy policy.

B6.name: Contact Information
B6.description: Provides contact channels (email, DPO, privacy department) for privacy-related inquiries.

B9.name: Use of Cookies or Similar Technology
B9.description: Discloses the deployment of HTTP cookies, web beacons, tracking pixels, or mobile tracking SDKs.

B22.name: Security Incident Notification
B22.description: Discloses procedures to notify affected individuals or regulatory authorities in the event of a security incident or data breach.

samples.name: Standard Enterprise SaaS Policy
samples.scenario: Comprehensive cloud SaaS policy with explicit title, date, contact, cookie disclosure, and incident notification.
samples.text:
Privacy Policy Name: Apex Cloud Platform Privacy Policy.
Effective Date: January 15, 2026.
Contact Information: privacy@apexcloud.io.
Our website uses persistent cookies and web beacons to remember user preferences and analyze performance.
If a security incident creates a regulatory notification obligation, we will notify affected individuals and relevant supervisory authorities without undue delay.

ground_truth_evidence: Privacy Policy Name: Apex Cloud Platform Privacy Policy.
B1.notes: Explicit 'Privacy Policy Name:' prefix clearly identifies the document title.

ground_truth_evidence: Effective Date: January 15, 2026.
B3.notes: Standard textual effective date format with explicit label.

ground_truth_evidence: Contact Information: privacy@apexcloud.io.
B6.notes: Explicit contact label and designated privacy email address.

ground_truth_evidence: Our website uses persistent cookies and web beacons to remember user preferences and analyze performance.
B9.notes: Affirmatively discloses browser cookies and web beacons.

ground_truth_evidence: If a security incident creates a regulatory notification obligation, we will notify affected individuals and relevant supervisory authorities without undue delay.
B22.notes: Contains commitments to notify affected individuals and authorities of security incidents.

samples.name: E-Commerce Store Customer Policy
samples.scenario: Retail store policy with title, ISO date, and DPO contact, but explicitly disclaiming cookies and omitting incident notifications.
samples.text:
Privacy Policy Title: ShopSphere Online Store Customer Privacy Policy.
Effective Date: 2026-03-01.
For questions regarding your data, contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy-team@shopsphere.com.
We do not use browser cookies or tracking pixels on our web store; our platform relies exclusively on temporary server sessions.
Customer orders are retained for billing purposes as required by commercial law.

ground_truth_evidence: Privacy Policy Title: ShopSphere Online Store Customer Privacy Policy.
B1.notes: Explicit 'Privacy Policy Title:' heading fulfills B1.

ground_truth_evidence: Effective Date: 2026-03-01.
For questions regarding your data, contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy-team@shopsphere.com.
B6.notes: Designates DPO contact channel with email.

B9.notes: Negative ground-truth: text explicitly disclaims cookies and tracking pixels ('We do not use browser cookies...').

B22.notes: Negative ground-truth: policy completely omits any mention of security incident or breach notification.

samples.name: B1 Boundary Case A - Explicit Prefix
samples.scenario: Tests B1 detection when explicit 'Privacy Policy Name:' prefix is present.
samples.text:
Privacy Policy Name: Example Services Privacy Policy.

B6.notes: Support email channel provided for inquiries.

samples.name: B1 Boundary Case B - Policy Title Prefix
samples.scenario: Tests B1 detection when alternative 'Policy Title:' prefix is used.
samples.text:
Policy Title: Example Services Privacy Policy.
Effective Date: 15 August 2026.
Users can email our privacy desk at privacy@example.org.

ground_truth_evidence: Policy Title: Example Services Privacy Policy.
B1.notes: Positive ground truth: explicit 'Policy Title:' marker is present.

ground_truth_evidence: Effective Date: 15 August 2026.

ground_truth_evidence: Users can email our privacy desk at privacy@example.org.

samples.name: B1 Boundary Case C - Bare Document Heading
samples.scenario: Tests B1 evaluation when the document heading lacks an explicit title descriptor cue.
samples.text:
Example Services Privacy Policy.
Effective Date: September 2026.
If you have questions, please reach out to dpo@example.com.

B1.notes: Negative ground-truth under engine evaluation rules: 'Example Services Privacy Policy.' lacks an explicit naming cue ('Privacy Policy Name:', 'Policy Title:', etc.) required to separate titles from body phrases.

ground_truth_evidence: Effective Date: September 2026.
B3.notes: Month-year date with effective date label.

ground_truth_evidence: If you have questions, please reach out to dpo@example.com.

samples.name: Culinary Cookies & Promotional Discount Distractor
samples.scenario: Near-miss test containing culinary cookies and promotional coupon dates that must not be counted as privacy indicators.
samples.text:
Welcome to the Baker's Hearth Community Portal.
This discount coupon is effective until Friday, December 31, 2026.
During our holiday festival, our staff baked fresh chocolate cookies for visitors in the reception lounge.
For general event questions, write to info@bakershearth.local.

B1.notes: Negative ground truth: welcome header for a community portal, not a privacy policy title.

B3.notes: Negative ground truth: 'effective until Friday' describes a promotional discount coupon, not a policy commencement date.

ground_truth_evidence: For general event questions, write to info@bakershearth.local.
B6.notes: Positive ground truth: valid email address and contact channel provided.

B9.notes: Negative ground truth: 'baked fresh chocolate cookies' refers to edible food, not HTTP browser tracking cookies.

samples.name: Marketing Newsletter & Reception Notification Distractor
samples.scenario: Near-miss test containing notify and inform keywords in non-security contexts.
samples.text:
Document Title: Greenfield Mobile Utilities Privacy Notice.
We notify newsletter subscribers whenever a new recipe article or gardening tip is published.
The receptionist informed the visitor that the conference room was ready.
If you need account assistance, email support@greenfieldapps.com.

ground_truth_evidence: Document Title: Greenfield Mobile Utilities Privacy Notice.
B1.notes: Positive ground truth: explicit 'Document Title:' header.

ground_truth_evidence: If you need account assistance, email support@greenfieldapps.com.

B22.notes: Negative ground truth: 'notify newsletter subscribers' and 'receptionist informed' refer to recipes and office visitors, completely unrelated to data security incidents.

samples.name: Mobile SDK Telemetry Policy Without Contact Details
samples.scenario: Mobile app policy covering tracking SDKs and breach notification but omitting all contact details.
samples.text:
Official User Privacy Policy: NexaTrack Fitness App.
Effective Date: 2026-05-20.
Our mobile application integrates third-party tracking SDKs and local storage identifiers to analyze workout trends and diagnostics.
In the event of a personal data breach, our emergency team will notify affected individuals promptly.

ground_truth_evidence: Official User Privacy Policy: NexaTrack Fitness App.
B1.notes: Positive ground truth: explicit 'Official User Privacy Policy' heading.

ground_truth_evidence: Effective Date: 2026-05-20.
B3.notes: ISO date with effective date marker.

B6.notes: Negative ground truth: policy completely omits contact information, email, or support channels.

ground_truth_evidence: Our mobile application integrates third-party tracking SDKs and local storage identifiers to analyze workout trends and diagnostics.
B9.notes: Explicitly discloses tracking SDKs and local identifiers.

ground_truth_evidence: In the event of a personal data breach, our emergency team will notify affected individuals promptly.
B22.notes: Explicit commitment to notify affected individuals upon personal data breach.

samples.name: Disjointed Keywords Across Sentences Trap
samples.scenario: Adversarial test where incident and notification words appear in separate sentences.
samples.text:
We conduct routine risk management across our cloud infrastructure.
Separately, we inform registered users about upcoming maintenance schedules.
Our company security policy protects corporate equipment.
For inquiries, please email contact@novasystems.net.

B1.notes: Negative ground truth: 'company security policy' refers to employee equipment guidelines, not an application privacy policy.

ground_truth_evidence: For inquiries, please email contact@novasystems.net.

B22.notes: Negative ground truth: 'risk' in sentence 1 and 'inform' in sentence 2 are separated across unrelated sentences discussing IT maintenance. No breach notification exists.

samples.name: Developer API Policy Omitting Tracking & Incidents
samples.scenario: API backend policy that disclaims cookies and omits breach notice procedures.
samples.text:
Privacy Policy Name: FastAPI Metrics Service Privacy Document.
Effective from: January 1, 2026.
We do not use cookies, web beacons, or tracking technologies of any kind.
Developers may contact our privacy engineers at api-privacy@metrics-fast.dev.

ground_truth_evidence: Privacy Policy Name: FastAPI Metrics Service Privacy Document.
Effective from: January 1, 2026.
Developers may contact our privacy engineers at api-privacy@metrics-fast.dev.

B9.notes: Negative ground truth: explicit negative declaration confirming cookies/tracking are NOT used.

B22.notes: Negative ground truth: security incident notification is not addressed in this policy.

samples.name: Smart Home IoT Hardware Device Policy
samples.scenario: Hardware IoT policy covering title, US slash date, session cookies, regulatory incident notice, and privacy email.
samples.text:
Privacy Policy Title: SmartTherm Home Thermostat Privacy Policy.
Effective Date: 04/01/2026.
Our companion web dashboard uses session cookies to store your temperature preference profile.
Should any security incident compromise your personal data, we will inform regulatory authorities and notify affected users in accordance with applicable laws.
You can reach our privacy support team at privacy@smarttherm-iot.com.

ground_truth_evidence: Privacy Policy Title: SmartTherm Home Thermostat Privacy Policy.
Effective Date: 04/01/2026.
B3.notes: US numerical date with effective date marker.

ground_truth_evidence: You can reach our privacy support team at privacy@smarttherm-iot.com.
Our companion web dashboard uses session cookies to store your temperature preference profile.
Should any security incident compromise your personal data, we will inform regulatory authorities and notify affected users in accordance with applicable laws.
B22.notes: Affirmative commitment to inform authorities and notify affected users of security incidents.

samples.name: Non-Privacy Corporate Document Negative Control
samples.scenario: Adversarial negative control containing corporate boilerplate, equipment policies, and sales email.
samples.text:
Please read this Privacy Policy carefully to understand our data practices.
We adhere to a strict company security policy regarding corporate equipment.
The yields on corporate investments were finalized yesterday.
For bulk enterprise sales pricing discounts, please write to sales@enterprise-widgets.corp.

B1.notes: Negative ground truth: generic phrase 'Please read this Privacy Policy carefully' is preamble boilerplate without a policy name.

B3.notes: Negative ground truth: no effective date present.

B6.notes: Negative ground truth: 'sales@enterprise-widgets.corp' for bulk enterprise sales pricing discounts is a commercial sales address, not a privacy contact.

B9.notes: Negative ground truth: no mention of cookies or tracking.

B22.notes: Negative ground truth: no security incident or breach notification procedure.
